title: Carmelle Collado hopes to connect global audiences through OPM at Eurovision Asia
summary: Carmelle Collado is hoping to introduce the heart of Original Pilipino Music (OPM) to a global audience as she represents the Philippines in the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia.
